Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.644 of 2023, under Section 376, 323, 506 IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. PGI, District Lucknow.

3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant who was studying in Class 8 was lured by the applicant who was the Auto Driver in which the daughter used to go to school and after administering some intoxicant, he committed wrong to her.

In the statement under Section 161 Israr @ Anna vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135307318/
1 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that since 20.09.2023, the applicant used to come home and on 26.09.2023, he had administered some medicine and thereafter, she fell unconscious and he took her to a hotel and committed wrong on her.

entities.text: Israr @ Anna vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was also stated that similar offence was committed on the next day but she could not inform her mother as she was suffering from depression and thereafter, he used to do the same for more than a week.
A similar statement was given under Section 164 Cr.P.C. that the applicant committed the offence from 24.09.2023 up to 07.10.2023.
The medical on record does not corroborate any of the allegations as levelled in the two statements.
There is no definite document on record to conclusively determine the age of the victim as prescribed under Section 94 of the Juvenile Justice Act 4.
Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that, as per the statement, physical relations were formed for more than a week or ten days without there being any protest and the medical does not corroborate the allegations, a case for bail is made out, particularly, when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 10.10.2023.

In view thereof, the application is allowed.
6.
